dialogues.speaker: Amoxcihuatl
dialogues.text: Creations of the northern tribes. Ingenious things. These metal instruments can perform music entirely on their own. No attendants required, only the ingenuity of their makers.

dialogues.speaker: Amoxcihuatl
dialogues.text: Still, I cannot help thinking such devices deserve a higher purpose. Imagine them spreading the wisdom of the Alliance, or the enlightened teachings of the glorious Holy Sov{RUBY#[D]Ti'sakhuun}ereign, rather than serving as mere instruments of music.

dialogues.speaker: Amoxcihuatl
dialogues.text: Sadly, Mr. Istoria will not permit me to modify the originals. So I have begun trying to recreate them from the ground up.

dialogues.speaker: Amoxcihuatl
dialogues.text: I am no craftsman. Lady Ixquieh, who sacrificed herself for the Alliance, possessed far greater skill than I do. My progress has been slow... Even so, I believe that determination can carry a person through anything.
